name: Kenneth Claremont
source:
The Prince of Volcano Kingdom and brother of Gwyneth. He was kidnapped when he was little and accidentally damaged his brain and speaking ability. As a result, he tends to stammer when speaking, but he has a kind heart. 

He has many scars on his body and wears turtlenecks daily to cover them. He was trained in the forest to fight, although the skill came to him naturally. Due to his time spent in the forest, he claims to have met the Owl Princess and gained an affinity for magical creatures.

Upon returning back to the Palace, he proactively takes a part in integrating with society once again.

[Edited from in-game bio]
